messages:
alicia: SAST started failing across CI this morning right after the RBAC change on keystore. Scanners report 403 on KMS Decrypt. Anyone seen this?
marco: yep, replicated in staging. Local repro shows `google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt` -> 403. PR that changed bindings is #3124 and landed ~40m ago.
secbot: [alert] CI pipeline: sast-scan (job 6832) failed. https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/6832 :warning:
samira: tagging @owen  we need a quick unblock so release isn't held up. Revert or emergency grant?
owen: Short-term: give the scan runner explicit decrypt permission for 1 hour. Long-term: the RBAC change assumed scanner used infra group's perms but pipeline runs as svc-scan-runner. Which principal does the pipeline use?
alicia: Pipeline uses `svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The RBAC rollout bound `roles/keystore.reader` to `group:infra-team@redwood`.
marco: Suggested quick command we used before (gcloud):
```
 gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
   --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
   --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
samira: do that but please record the policy binding id and add a note to audit logs ingestion so Splunk can pick it up (`resource.type=\"kms_key\" protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt`). We need evidence for postmortem.
owen: I'll apply an ephemeral binding and post the binding fingerprint. Also will trigger a rerun once applied.
alicia: opening an incident for tracking: https://incident.redwood.example/INC-2026-0928 - tag: sdlc-scan-kms-failure
secbot: [incident] INC-2026-0928 created by alicia. PagerDuty alerted.
marco: triage checklist I'm putting in the incident: 1) grant ephemeral decrypt role to svc-scan-runner, 2) re-run SAST jobs, 3) collect KMS audit log entries for Decrypt failures, 4) if failures persist rollback PR #3124, 5) add preflight smoke test to RBAC rollout pipeline.
samira: Agree on the checklist. I'll draft the runbook change under \"SAST KMS decrypt failures\" to reflect ephemeral grants and the preflight mock-decrypt step.
owen: ephemeral grant applied (binding id: bind-2026-09-28-01). Re-run queued. Posting command for revoke afterwards.
alicia: FYI DAST health checks also started flapping but not yet correlated. Creating separate ticket if it persists.
secbot: [automation] Re-run requested for CI job 6832 by owen.
marco: If the rerun passes, we should: a) revoke the ephemeral grant, b) revert the premature rollout of #3124, and c) schedule a safer rollout with explicit mapping for pipeline service accounts.
owen: Rerun passed green. I'm revoking the binding now and will add the preflight check to the RBAC rollout workflow (mock decrypt using svc-scan-runner identity).
samira: After-action items: - samira to update runbook (PR to docs), - alicia to own postmortem writeup, - marco to draft comms for Dedicated customers if prod pipelines were at risk.
alicia: I'll take the postmortem and coordinate internal post-incident review. Please attach KMS audit slices to the incident (time range 1783456700-1783457400).
marco: grabbing logs and adding to incident. Noting we need to improve deploy checklist: include \"verify scanner SA decrypts key\" step.
owen: I'll implement a lightweight smoke test in the RBAC deploy job and add a policy to fail rollout if mock decrypt fails.
samira: Thanks all. Small win but good reminder: service-account assumptions are brittle. Add explicit mapping in infra docs. :thumbsup:
